item.title: Ginwoo Onodera Makes History at Street League Skateboarding
item.description: Huge congrats to Ginwoo Onodera! For the first time ever in Street League Skateboarding history, a skater scored 9+ on all seven trick attempts . A ll in the same day, Ginwoo turned 16, won SLS Sydney, and made history. The scores: Line 1 — 9.1 Line 2 — 9.4 Trick Attempt 1 — 9.1 Trick Attempt 2 — 9.2 Trick Attempt 3 — 9.5 Trick Attempt 4 — 9.0 Trick Attempt 5 — 9.2 Seven attempts. All 9s. The best men's performance of all time. We’re watching a legend in the making, in real time.
